title: Titanium Orthodontic Archwire
alloyReason: Nitinol (ASTM F2063) is specified for this dental self-expanding application where 55-60Ni wt% delivers superelastic recovery up to 8% at body temp. Af temperature is set 10-15C below operating temp for complete austenitic transformation. This rationale is driven by self-adjusting orthodontic archwire (nitinol) and service environment demands.
process: CNC swiss turning for dental geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for selfadjusting orthodontic archwire application
inspection: Mech test ASTM per std (selfadjusting orthodontic verified)
commonFailures: Fe contamination from machining - requires acid passivation 20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C per ASTM F86 — critical for selfadjusting orthodontic archwire performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Orthodontic Archwire suitable for Self-adjusting orthodontic archwire (Nitinol)?
faq.a: Titanium Orthodontic Archwire uses Nitinol because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address dental operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Orthodontic Archwire?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Orthodontic Archwire is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for selfadjusting orthodontic archwire requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Orthodontic Archwire require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. selfadjusting orthodontic archwire components require Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for selfadjusting orthodontic archwire application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Orthodontic Archwire shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Orthodontic Archwire includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet selfadjusting orthodontic archwire specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Braces wire / Archwire dental components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
